Slow melancholic intro: "Ek chilam ek baabaa do ghade ka khel". Verse about broken pot crying to baba. Chorus with claps: "Baabaa bole mat ro re deewaane / Jo raste pe phool khile hain / Wo teri boondon ke hai bahaane / Kuch bhi vyarth nahi jaaye". Key change to bright. Climax with "Toota ghada gaaye" repeating, "Kal wapas" three times. Outro fades with single tabla tak tak tak. Emotional arc from sadness to ecstasy. 4-5 minutes.
